review.method: Rendered proof frames plus a 32-frame contact sheet spanning the encoded film and a targeted encoded frame at 12.8 seconds
review.technical: Full decode passed: 480 frames, 1920x1080, 30 fps, 16 seconds; repeated and backward seeks passed; intentionally silent
review.editability: Replaced every phrase, palette, and seed in a temporary content.json while keeping scene code unchanged; longer copy fit and rendered seek checks passed
repairs: Opening starts with a visible thought instead of an empty first frame
Final text mask expanded and underline lowered to preserve the serif g descender
First interruption begins before the cut so its incoming frame is visible
Final underline settles below the descenders before the second line becomes visible
review.limitation: Normal-speed playback was not directly reviewed; dense encoded frames and transition proofs were inspected. Source and assets reproduce the scene; the same natural-language prompt alone does not guarantee the same creative decisions
